subtopic: Parametric vs Non-Parametric Tests (t-test, ANOVA, Mann-Whitney)
question_text: [Probability, Statistics & Hypothesis Testing - Q46] When continuous response data violates normal distribution assumptions and exhibits severe skewness with small sample sizes (N=18), which statistical test is most appropriate to compare two independent groups?
answer_explanation: The Mann-Whitney U test is a non-parametric test evaluating stochastic equality based on ranks, requiring no normality assumption.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: The Mann-Whitney U test is a non-parametric test evaluating stochastic equality based on ranks, requiring no normality assumption.
